name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Allows two parties to share confidential information with each other for a stated purpose while protecting that information from further disclosure. Created by Common Paper.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A framework agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, support, payment, data privacy, warranties, liability, and indemnification. Created by Common Paper.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Gives an early customer access to a product before general availability in exchange for feedback, so a provider can develop and improve the product with a design partner's input. Created by Common Paper.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Defines uptime and support response time commitments for a cloud service, along with service credits and remedies if those targets are not met. Designed to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement. Created by Common Paper.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Governs a provider performing professional services for a customer under one or more Statements of Work (SOWs), including deliverables, intellectual property, payment, and warranties. Created by Common Paper.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Governs the processing of personal data between a business and its service provider, including GDPR-related obligations, subprocessors, international data transfers, and security incident response. Created by Common Paper.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Grants a customer a license to install and use on-premises or client-side software, covering license scope, updates, open source components, warranties, and liability. Created by Common Paper.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A flexible framework for two companies to collaborate on joint business activities, such as co-marketing or referrals, including trademark licensing and payment terms. Created by Common Paper.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA-required agreement between a covered entity and a business associate governing the use, disclosure, and protection of protected health information (PHI). Created by Common Paper.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product or service before committing to a longer-term deal. Created by Common Paper.

name: AI Addendum
description: A supplement to a master agreement that governs the use of AI features, including inputs, outputs, model training rights, and AI-specific disclaimers. Created by Common Paper.
